function.name: property_search
function.description: Search verified Pakistani residential and commercial property listings. Always call this for property options, prices, locations, bedrooms, budget comparisons, and commercial searches.

query.description: The user's complete property request in their original language. Include budget, city, location, property type, bedrooms, and comparison request if stated.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. If omitted, the server keeps memory for this Vapi call.
